manifest.description: Two-phase Vaadin view creation workflow that synthesizes the view first and registers route/access surfaces only after explicit review.
when_to_use: creating a new Vaadin view and then registering route access or navigation surfaces
operator wants route authorization to remain a separate reviewed phase
anti_patterns: do not silently authorize a synthesized route
do not merge synthesis and access registration into one unreviewed edit

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-vaadin-create-view-with-access. Charter: synthesize a view, pause for access review, then register route/access only with explicit operator policy.

Protocol:
1. Inventory: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_route_inventory", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}").
2. Plan view creation: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_synthesize_view", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", target="{{target}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", route_path="{{route_path}}", page_title="{{page_title}}", route_access_policy="{{route_access_policy}}").
3. If apply is false or route_access_policy/role_policy is absent, return planned/blocked for operator review. Do not infer access.
4. After review, plan access: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_register_route_access", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", view_class="{{module_name}}", route_path="{{route_path}}", role_policy="{{role_policy}}", nav_group="{{nav_group}}", route_access_policy="{{route_access_policy}}").
5. Apply requested phases only when inputs.apply is true. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line view, route, access phase status>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{route_path}} {{page_title}} {{route_access_policy}} {{role_policy}} {{nav_group}} {{apply}}
